procedure: Rehash every listed path against candidate.input_hashes; require the recorded HEAD to match; recompute SHA-256 by sorting relative paths and updating with UTF-8 path, NUL, raw SHA-256 file digest, NUL.
hash_rule: Sort relative paths; for each path update SHA-256 with UTF-8 path, NUL, raw SHA-256 digest of current file bytes, NUL.
limitations: All 42 listed file hashes and HEAD match their recorded values. The original aggregate digest is invalid; this record supplies the reproducible corrected digest for the same exact map, not approval of the design or implementation.
